independence_evidence: About page: published by Musicworks Society of Ontario Inc., a non-profit organization supported by arts councils, subscriptions, advertising and donations.
qualifies_reason: Non-profit Toronto magazine with Issue 154 (Summer 2026) on sale and three print issues a year.
what_it_is: A Canadian magazine about experimental music and sound art, with long profiles of composers, improvisers and electronic artists, festival and album reviews, and a companion CD of recordings tied to each issue. It appears three times a year. Readers are musicians, composers, students and listeners who follow new and exploratory music.
